name: no_flip
hypothesis: Disabling the momentum-flip exit (identical entries and stops, no HA-flip close) improves expectancy: the offline study graded the flip a mild drag but could not confirm it out-of-sample, so the live same-sample A/B decides whether the flip is retired.
stopping_rule: Settle when the paired same-sample 95% delta CI half-width vs baseline reaches 0.15R (n>=20, clusters>=8). Retire the arm if the upper bound (IID) < +0.10R. Retire the momentum-flip exit from the live config only if the clustered lower bound > 0 net @0.05 ATR -- the forward book, not the offline study, decides.
provenance: Back-registered 2026-07-10 from the build_arms docstring in src/swing_screener/pipeline/arms.py; sha is the PR #64 commit that introduced the roster line.

name: partial33_cond
hypothesis: A conditional 33% scale-out, taken only when HA momentum is softening, banks profit on fading moves without capping the runners -- beating the all-or-nothing baseline exit (Step C).
stopping_rule: Settle when the paired same-sample 95% delta CI half-width vs baseline reaches 0.15R (n>=20, clusters>=8). Retire the arm if the upper bound (IID) < +0.10R. Promotion consideration only if the clustered lower bound > 0 net @0.05 ATR -- the shadow book remains the promotion arbiter.
provenance: Back-registered 2026-07-10 from the build_arms docstring in src/swing_screener/pipeline/arms.py; sha is the PR #33 (Step C parallel-arm dual-book) commit that introduced the roster line.

name: partial33_chand
hypothesis: The same conditional 33% partial, but the post-partial remainder rides a 3.0-ATR Chandelier trail instead of a static breakeven stop; the Step D bake-off pits it against partial33_cond -- same partial, different runner management.
stopping_rule: Settle when the paired same-sample 95% delta CI half-width vs baseline reaches 0.15R (n>=20, clusters>=8). Retire the arm if the upper bound (IID) < +0.10R. Promotion consideration only if the clustered lower bound > 0 net @0.05 ATR; the Step D bake-off read is this arm's delta vs partial33_cond on the same fills.
provenance: Back-registered 2026-07-10 from the build_arms docstring in src/swing_screener/pipeline/arms.py; sha is the PR #34 (Step D Chandelier runner trail) commit that introduced the roster line.

name: be_1r
hypothesis: Pre-partial stops otherwise never move, so every trade rides FULL initial risk to the end; ratcheting the stop to breakeven once the prior bar's high-water clears entry +1R cuts give-backs (21.6% of reversal trades that touch +1R close at <=0) -- the classic cheap high-information exit experiment.
stopping_rule: Settle when the paired_arm_delta 95% CI half-width vs baseline reaches 0.15R (n>=20, clusters>=8). Retire the arm if the upper bound (IID) < +0.10R. Promotion consideration only if the clustered lower bound > 0 net @0.05 ATR -- the paired same-sample delta, not the MAE study, decides.
provenance: Back-registered 2026-07-10 from the roster comment in src/swing_screener/pipeline/arms.py; sha is the PR #93 (2026-07 experiment queue) commit that introduced the roster line.

name: extguard_tight
hypothesis: The live freshness gate ships at max_extension_atr 2.0; a tighter 1.5 rejects already-extended chase entries and improves the continuation book -- the forward bake-off of the gate threshold.
stopping_rule: Settle when the clustered 95% delta CI half-width vs default on the continuation book reaches 0.15R (n>=20, clusters>=8). Retire if the clustered upper bound < +0.10R. Tighten the live gate only if the clustered lower bound > 0 net @0.05 ATR -- the shadow book remains the promotion arbiter.
provenance: Back-registered 2026-07-10 from the build_screen_variants docstring in src/swing_screener/pipeline/variants.py; sha is the PR #37 (screener freshness fix) commit that introduced the roster line.

name: rev_confirm1
hypothesis: The LEGACY next-bar-only confirmation, kept as the counterfactual book after the default flipped to reversal_confirm_window=3 (2026-07-03 rotation-capture screen: the late-confirm increment graded +0.110R, 95%-low +0.065 at 0.05 slippage and held at 0.10, while legacy-only no longer cleared the bar).

Retire once the clustered upper bound < +0.10R (the windowed default is confirmed).
